name: fastly-reference-architectures
description: Curated GitHub repositories demonstrating working reference architectures on the Fastly platform, from single Compute applications to systems combining multiple Fastly products. Use when designing a new solution on Fastly and a worked example of the target pattern would help, or when implementing and a concrete assembled reference would clarify the shape of the code. Not for documentation of how a specific Fastly tool or API works on its own — see the tool-specific skills for that.
